_metadata.description: Parametric crop insurance drought severity tier thresholds.
_metadata.warning: CRITICAL: All cut-offs in this file are RESEARCH ASSUMPTIONS for Andhra Pradesh Kharif groundnut. They must remain configurable and should never be hard-coded into smart contracts or scripts. Thresholds are calibrated relative to historical baseline medians (leave-one-year-out).

weather_rainfall.description: Percentage deficit relative to historical median seasonal rainfall (1 June - 31 October).

tier_0_normal.note: ASSUMPTION: Deficit <= 20% indicates normal or mild variation without catastrophic loss.

tier_1_moderate.note: ASSUMPTION: Deficit 20-40% indicates moderate drought stress.

tier_2_severe.note: ASSUMPTION: Deficit 40-60% indicates severe drought conditions.

tier_3_catastrophic.note: ASSUMPTION: Deficit > 60% indicates total crop failure level drought.

satellite_ndvi.description: Percentage drop relative to historical median peak NDVI over the Kharif season.

tier_0_normal.note: ASSUMPTION: NDVI deficit <= 15% indicates healthy crop vegetative growth.

tier_1_moderate.note: ASSUMPTION: NDVI deficit 15-30% indicates noticeable canopy stunting or stress.

tier_2_severe.note: ASSUMPTION: NDVI deficit 30-45% indicates significant vegetative loss.

tier_3_catastrophic.note: ASSUMPTION: NDVI deficit > 45% indicates widespread vegetation failure.

soil_moisture.description: Percentage drop relative to historical median root-zone / surface soil moisture.

tier_0_normal.note: ASSUMPTION: Soil moisture deficit <= 15% indicates adequate soil moisture.

tier_1_moderate.note: ASSUMPTION: Soil moisture deficit 15-30% indicates moderate root-zone water depletion.

tier_2_severe.note: ASSUMPTION: Soil moisture deficit 30-45% indicates acute soil moisture deficit.

tier_3_catastrophic.note: ASSUMPTION: Soil moisture deficit > 45% indicates severe moisture desiccation.
